metric_notes.suite: Paired alternating-order subprocesses, one discarded cycle, original work sizes, both JIT and interpreter.
metric_notes.probes: Interpreter only; seven measured cycles for kernels and 31 for startup, one discarded cycle.
metric_notes.rss: Per-child peak resident memory; includes process startup.
metric_notes.time: Workload timers exclude startup; startup probes use full-process wall time.
metric_notes.warm: Seven measured cycles after one discarded cycle. Each subprocess invokes bench(n) once before timing a second invocation and records workload CPU time.
metric_notes.scaling: Existing eight-thread fixture, five measured cycles and one discarded cycle, both binaries and both GIL modes. Work values are 1,000,000 and 3,000,000 per worker.
